portName: Port of Kiel (Ostseekai, Ostuferhafen, Schwedenkai, Norwegenkai)
seoTitle: Kiel cruise port guide: Ostseekai, Ostuferhafen, Laboe
seoDescription: Kiel's Ostseekai is 300 m from the centre; Ostuferhafen is 8 km out (bus 11 or X60). City bus €3.00 (2026). Laboe ferry about 1 hr; Lübeck 1 hr 36 by train.
quickAnswer: Most cruise ships use the Ostseekai, about 300 m from Kiel city centre and 15 minutes' walk from the main station; Schwedenkai and Norwegenkai are also walkable. Ostuferhafen, on the east bank, is about 8 km out, so take bus 11 or X60 (single €3.00, 2026) and walk about 15 minutes from the Grenzstraße stop, or a taxi. Be back on board 60 minutes before all-aboard, or 90 if you went to Laboe by ferry or to Lübeck by train.
intro: Kiel is a working port city at the head of the Kiel Fjord, at the Baltic end of the Kiel Canal. On a port call the city offers a compact centre, the Kiellinie waterfront promenade and good access to the fjord by public ferry. The best half-day out is Laboe, an hour up the fjord, with its naval memorial and the U 995 submarine. Lübeck's old town is a popular but long train trip. Your berth matters: the Ostseekai is in town, while Ostuferhafen is a freight harbour on the far side of the fjord.

terminals.name: Ostseekai (Terminals 27/28)
terminals.notes: Main cruise terminal with two berths and boarding bridges, shore power. About 300 m from the city centre and 1.6 km, about 15 minutes on foot, from Kiel Hauptbahnhof through the pedestrian zone. Buses 41, 42, 61 and 62 stop at 'Seegarten Ostseekai'.

terminals.name: Ostuferhafen (Berth 1)
terminals.notes: Freight and logistics harbour on the east bank, used for large cruise ships; 395 m quay with shore power. Not practical on foot. Bus 11 or X60 from the main station towards Dietrichsdorf to 'Grenzstraße', then about 15 minutes on foot to check-in, or a taxi.

terminals.name: Schwedenkai (Berths 24/25)
terminals.notes: Stena Line ferry terminal for Gothenburg on the east side of the city port, occasionally used by cruise ships. About 10 minutes on foot from the main station.

terminals.name: Norwegenkai (Berths 21/22)
terminals.notes: Color Line ferry terminal for Oslo, also used by smaller cruise ships. About 300 m from the city centre, reached over the Hörnbrücke footbridge opposite the main station.

walkability.detail: From the Ostseekai the city centre is about 300 m away and the main station about 15 minutes on foot. Norwegenkai and Schwedenkai are about 10 minutes from the station. Ostuferhafen is about 8 km out and not walkable.

transportSections.time: About 15 min Ostseekai to the main station; about 10 min from Norwegenkai or Schwedenkai
transportSections.detail: From the Ostseekai the route runs through the pedestrian zone. From Norwegenkai cross the Hörnbrücke footbridge to the station.

transportSections.cost: €3.00 single, €7.60 Kiel city day ticket (from 1 April 2026)
transportSections.detail: Buses 41, 42, 61 and 62 serve 'Seegarten Ostseekai'. For Ostuferhafen take bus 11 or X60 from the main station towards Dietrichsdorf to 'Grenzstraße', then walk about 15 minutes. Bus 11 also goes to 'Kiel Wik-Kanal' for the Kiel Canal locks.

transportSections.mode: Fjord ferry to Laboe (SFK line F1)
transportSections.cost: SH tariff; a Kiel–Laboe day ticket is €11.70 (2026)
transportSections.detail: Ferries leave from the Bahnhofsbrücke pier by the main station and call at Friedrichsort and Möltenort on the way. They run more often from mid-March to autumn; check the SFK timetable for the return before you go.

transportSections.cost: From €19.98 one way on some departures (Deutsche Bahn, 2026)
transportSections.detail: About 41 connections a day from Kiel Hauptbahnhof. On the dates checked, Deutsche Bahn showed no direct train, so you will change at least once. Check the return connection before leaving.
Taxis wait at Kiel Hauptbahnhof around the clock without booking. Recommended for Ostuferhafen.

returnTiming.rule: Be back on board 60 minutes before all-aboard. If you go to Laboe by ferry or to Lübeck by train, plan to be back on board 90 minutes before. If your ship is at Ostuferhafen, leave Kiel Hauptbahnhof at least 120 minutes before all-aboard.
returnTiming.detail: The Laboe ferry takes about an hour and is not frequent, so missing one can cost a long wait. The Lübeck trip is over 90 minutes each way with changes. Ostuferhafen adds a bus ride plus a 15-minute walk from the Grenzstraße stop.
returnTiming.emergencyFallback: From Laboe, buses 100 and 102 run to Kiel if you miss a ferry, or take a taxi. From Kiel Hauptbahnhof take a taxi to your berth. If you will miss all-aboard, call the port agent number on your daily programme.

diyVsExcursion.ship: From US$129 for about 4 hours with Holland America (2026); other lines vary
diyVsExcursion.diy: Kiel–Laboe day ticket €11.70 plus memorial and U 995 combination ticket €14 (2026)
diyVsExcursion.saving: Not calculated: prices are in different currencies

diyVsExcursion.ship: Varies by line; check your cruise planner
diyVsExcursion.diy: Free on foot from the Ostseekai

excursionAdvice: From the Ostseekai, skip the ship tour for Kiel itself: the centre and the Kiellinie are on foot. Laboe is easy on your own by ferry on a normal-length call, and much cheaper than a ship tour, but it ties you to the ferry timetable. A ship tour is the safer choice for Lübeck, because the train trip is more than 90 minutes each way with changes, and for passengers whose ship is at Ostuferhafen.

dayPlan.intro: Assumes the ship docks at the Ostseekai at 08:00 and all-aboard is 17:30. Check the SFK ferry timetable for your date first and adjust the times.

steps.what: Walk through the centre to the Bahnhofsbrücke pier by the main station, about 15 minutes.
Take the fjord ferry F1 to Laboe, about one hour.
Laboe Naval Memorial (opens 10:00): lift to the first platform, then U 995 on the beach below. Combination ticket €14 (2026).
Lunch, for example a fish roll at Fischküche Laboe, Hafenplatz 1, then a walk on the beach promenade.
Kiel: climb the Rathaus tower or visit the Maritime Museum in the old fish market hall.
Walk part of the Kiellinie waterfront promenade.
Back on board, 60 minutes before all-aboard.

sights.name: Laboe Naval Memorial (Marine-Ehrenmal)
sights.why: A 72 m tower memorial to sailors of all nations lost at sea, with a viewing deck 85 m above sea level over the Baltic.
sights.tip: Open 10:00–17:30 from April to October, 10:00–16:00 from November to March. Two lifts; the top platform needs 40 extra steps.

sights.name: U 995 submarine, Laboe
sights.why: A Second World War Type VII U-boat on the beach below the memorial, now a technical museum.
sights.tip: Buy the combination ticket if you also visit the memorial.

sights.name: Kiellinie
sights.why: Kiel's main waterfront promenade along the fjord, with views of ships and the GEOMAR seal pool.
sights.tip: Free bathing spots at Kiellinie and Bellevue have toilets and changing rooms.

sights.name: Kiel Canal locks, Holtenau viewing platform
sights.why: A platform above the Holtenau locks at the Baltic end of the Kiel Canal, opened in 1895 and about 100 km long, where ships of all sizes lock through.
sights.tip: Open sunrise to sunset at Maklerstraße 1. Take bus 11 to 'Kiel Wik-Kanal'.

sights.name: Kiel Maritime Museum
sights.why: Kiel's maritime history, including the 1918 sailors' mutiny, in the former fish market hall by the harbour.
sights.cost: Check the museum's site for 2026 prices
sights.tip: A good rainy-day stop close to the Ostseekai.

sights.name: Kiel Rathaus tower
sights.why: Climb 67 m up the 106 m town hall tower at Fleethörn 9 for a view over the centre and the fjord.
sights.cost: Check locally for 2026 prices and tour times
sights.tip: In the city centre, a short walk from the Ostseekai.

sights.name: Lübeck old town
sights.why: A UNESCO World Heritage old town island with the 15th-century Holstentor gate, the Marienkirche and the European Hansemuseum.
sights.timeNeeded: Full day: about 3 hr 15 min of train travel plus sightseeing
sights.cost: Train from €19.98 one way on some departures (2026); museum fees extra
sights.tip: Only on a long call. The Buddenbrookhaus is closed for renovation until around 2028.

beaches.name: Laboe beach
beaches.howToGetThere: Fjord ferry F1 from the Bahnhofsbrücke
beaches.note: Swimming in the sea, a car-free promenade and ship-watching, next to the naval memorial.

beaches.name: Kiellinie and Bellevue bathing spots
beaches.note: Bathing spots with toilets and changing rooms on the city waterfront.

beaches.name: Falckensteiner Strand
beaches.note: One of Kiel's most popular beaches.

food.where: Jan, Hein, Klaas and Pit Seafood, Kiellinie 61

commonMistakes.mistake: Assuming every Kiel berth is in town.
commonMistakes.fix: Ostuferhafen is about 8 km out. Check your berth and plan bus 11, X60 or a taxi.

commonMistakes.mistake: Going to Laboe without checking the ferry back.
commonMistakes.fix: Note the return times on the SFK timetable before boarding; the trip takes about an hour.

commonMistakes.mistake: Treating Lübeck as a quick hop.
commonMistakes.fix: The train takes about 1 hr 36 min each way with changes. Only go on a long call and be back on board 90 minutes early.

commonMistakes.mistake: Arriving at the Laboe memorial before opening.
commonMistakes.fix: It opens at 10:00 all year; time your ferry accordingly.

commonMistakes.mistake: Buying single bus tickets for several rides.
commonMistakes.fix: The Kiel city day ticket is €7.60 (2026); the Kiel–Laboe day ticket is €11.70.

safety: Kiel is a safe city for visitors. Take normal care with bags around the main station and in the pedestrian zone. At Ostuferhafen you walk through a working freight harbour from the bus stop, so stay on marked paths and watch for lorries. In Laboe, the memorial's upper steps and the submarine's hatches need care.
accessibility: The Ostseekai has boarding bridges, and the route into the flat city centre is short. Ostuferhafen requires a 15-minute walk from the bus stop, so a taxi is better for anyone with limited mobility. At Laboe the naval memorial has two lifts and wheelchair users can reach the first platform; the top platform needs 40 more steps, and a staff-operated stair lift links the halls. Accessible toilets are available.
rainyDay: Use the Maritime Museum near the harbour and the Laboe memorial halls. The Laboe ferry still runs in rain but the view suffers. The Holtenau lock platform is open-air.
crowdTips: Kiel is busiest during Kieler Woche, the city's sailing festival, when the waterfront, ferries and trains fill up. The Laboe ferry and the memorial are the main draws for independent passengers, so take an early ferry. Ostseekai can handle up to 11,000 passengers a day, so expect queues at the bus stops and the station on multi-ship days.

faqs.q: Is Kiel walkable from the cruise port?
faqs.a: From the Ostseekai, yes: the centre is about 300 m away and the main station about 15 minutes on foot. From Ostuferhafen, no.

faqs.q: How do I get from Kiel Ostuferhafen to the city centre?
faqs.a: Walk about 15 minutes to the Grenzstraße stop and take bus 11 or X60 to the main station, or take a taxi. A single bus ticket is €3.00 (2026).
No. Ships berth at the Ostseekai, Ostuferhafen, Schwedenkai or Norwegenkai.

faqs.q: How do I get from Kiel to Laboe?
faqs.a: Take fjord ferry F1 from the Bahnhofsbrücke by the main station, about one hour; buses 100 and 102 also run.

faqs.q: Can I visit Lübeck from Kiel cruise port?
faqs.a: Yes, by train in about 1 hr 36 min each way with changes. It is a long day; be back on board 90 minutes before all-aboard.

faqs.q: What can I do in Kiel in one day from a cruise ship?
faqs.a: Take the ferry to Laboe for the naval memorial and U 995, then walk the Kiellinie and see the Maritime Museum or Rathaus tower.
The Kiellinie and Bellevue bathing spots are walkable from the Ostseekai; Laboe and Falckensteiner Strand are reached by fjord ferry.
Yes. Take normal care around the main station and on the walk through the freight harbour at Ostuferhafen.
